notes.title: Mafia: The Old Country is available for pre-purchase, launching August 8!
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UOIg2lFVsJE

[i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i] is now available for pre-purchase on Steam. The game will offer two editions, [i]Standard Edition[/i] and [i]Deluxe Edition[/i], both of which release on August 8, 2025.

We're also excited to reveal that [i]Standard Edition[/i] and [i]Deluxe Edition[/i] will be priced at $49.99 and $59.99 respectively.* [i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i] is a compelling story that doesn't require a massive time commitment, and we believe these prices reflect the value of this highly-polished linear narrative experience.

Uncover the origins of organized crime in this gritty mob story set in the brutal underworld of 1900s Sicily. Fight to survive as Enzo Favara and prove your worth to the Cosa Nostra in this immersive third-person action-adventure set during a dangerous, unforgiving era.

Enzo will do anything for a better life. After a brutal childhood of forced labor, he's ready to risk everything to become a man of honor in the Torrisi crime family.

His oath to the Cosa Nostra, with all the power, temptation, and hardship it entails, is a burning reminder of this simple truth:

[b]Family Takes Sacrifice.[/b]

This thrilling narrative is brought to life by stunning visuals, cinematic storytelling, and the authentic realism that the critically acclaimed [i]Mafia[/i] series is known for. Enzo's story unfolds in a time when skill with a stiletto blade was a deadly asset, a [i]lupara[/i] sawed-off shotgun was a go-to firearm, murderous vendettas raged for decades, and mafiosi patrolled their protection rackets on foot, horseback, or behind the wheel of turn-of-the-century motorcars.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45157904/7efb125b6ee696625f3f107f7fa36b0c31542893.png[/img]

[h1]Pre-Purchase Bonus**[/h1]

Pre-purchase [i]Mafia: The Old Country Standard[/i] or [i]Deluxe Edition[/i] to receive The Soldato Pack, featuring weapon and character cosmetics, along with a helpful Charm that Enzo can equip for a passive in-game effect.**
[h2]The Soldato Pack contains:[/h2]
[list]
[*] "Soldato" Outfit
[*] "Scannaturi Speciale" Knife
[*] "Tesoro" Horse and Accessories
[*] "Lupara" Charm
[/list]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45157904/00595ccbd7ca859ffa448cd730d1da86e2c2ab25.png[/img]

[h1]Deluxe Edition[/h1]

[i]Mafia: The Old Country Deluxe Edition[/i] lets you descend into Sicily's criminal underworld in true Cosa Nostra style with a variety of bonus items for your collection.

[h2][i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i] Deluxe Edition includes:[/h2]
[list]
[*][h3] Full base game[/h3]
[*] [h3]Padrino Pack***[/h3]
[list]
[*] "Lupara Speciale" Shotgun
[*] "Vendetti Speciale" Pistol
[*] "Immortale" Charm
[*] "Padrino" Outfit
[*] "Stiletto Speciale" Knife
[*] "Eckhart Speciale" Limousine
[*] "Cosimo" Horse and Accessories
[/list]
[*] [h3]Gatto Nero Pack***[/h3]
[list]
[*] "Bodeo Nero" Pistol
[*] "Velocità" Charm
[*] "Gatto Nero" Outfit
[*] "Carozella Nero" Race Car
[/list]
[*] [h3]Bonus Materials***[/h3]
[list]
[*] Digital Artbook
[*] Original Score
[/list]
[/list]
In addition to the full base game, purchasing [i]Mafia: The Old Country Deluxe Edition[/i] also grants you the Padrino Pack and the Gatto Nero Pack, plus digital Bonus Materials.***

The Padrino Pack lets you outfit Enzo with an ornate arsenal and accoutrements befitting a godfather with the special weapons, cosmetic items, and Charm that provides a passive in-game effect. The Gatto Nero Pack also lets you outfit Enzo like a member of an exclusive club with a special weapon, cosmetic items, and a Charm that provides a passive in-game effect. 

Additionally, the [i]Deluxe Edition[/i]'s included Bonus Materials, available in-game at launch, let you listen to the sweeping original score of [i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i] with the official soundtrack, and browse a digital artbook full of gorgeous concept art with behind-the-scenes insights from the developers. The original score for [i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i] was composed by BT, aka Brian Transeau, and was performed by the Czech National Symphony Orchestra. It also includes a number of traditional Sicilian folk songs, arranged by Peter McConnell and performed by a selection of Sicilian and American musicians.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45157904/c0b75f7366595e269c4c53c9b4aaa95749c8203d.png[/img]

[h1]2K Account rewards[/h1]

To expand your in-game collection even more, [url=https://mafia.2k.com/2k-account-rewards/]signing up for a free 2K Account[/url] earns you the "Garzia Tumulto" Race Car in-game reward, and playing past [i]Mafia[/i] titles while logged into a 2K Account will unlock additional rewards, as detailed in this [url=https://mafia.2k.com/the-old-country/news/mafia-franchise-loyalty-rewards/]Mafia Franchise Rewards[/url] article. Along with these items, signing up for a 2K Account also lets you sign up for newsletters, unlocking the "Lupara Tradituri" Shotgun and ensuring that you stay informed of all the latest [i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i] reveals.**** 

Also be sure to check out our [url=https://mafia.2k.com/the-old-country/faq/]updated FAQs page[/url], which addresses all of our most commonly asked questions about [i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i].

And if you couldn't make it to our PAX East Developer Panel, catch up on everything you missed in our official recap [url=https://mafia.2k.com/the-old-country/news/pax-panel-family-takes-sacrifice/]here[/url]. Hosted by Kinda Funny's Greg Miller, longtime [i]Mafia[/i] developers from Hangar 13 gave an in-depth look back at the history of the franchise, as well as glimpses at how they brought 1900s Sicily to life in [i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1941540/Mafia_The_Old_Country/

[i]*Pricing and availability may vary by region and retailer and are subject to retailers’ own terms. See retailers’ site for specific details and terms.

**Pre-purchase offer available for Mafia: The Old Country Standard Edition and Deluxe Edition until August 8, 2025. Internet connection required to redeem bonus content. Items will be automatically entitled in-game at launch. Terms apply.

***Internet connection and base game required. Padrino Pack, Gatto Nero Pack, and Bonus Materials are included in the Deluxe Edition of Mafia: The Old Country.

****Each reward requires an internet connection and a 2K Account linked to the applicable Mafia title. One of each reward per 2K Account. Reward will be automatically entitled in the applicable game. Void where prohibited. Terms apply.[/i]

notes.title: The Team Behind Mafia: The Old Country Heads to PAX East!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157904/965ba7cd91fcd67ca265daf13929d3432aceeaf9.png[/img]
Mafia fans understand the seriousness of breaking Omertá, so don't miss this chance to uncover the origins of organized crime with Mafia: The Old Country at PAX East!

On [b]May 8[/b] at [i]7pm BST[/i] and [i]2pm ET[/i], watch as Hangar 13 developers debut a new Gameplay Trailer and offer a rare behind-the-scenes look at the past, present, and future of this storied franchise, live from their panel discussion via the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/pax]PAX East Main Stream[/url] and the [url=https://www.youtube.com/@mafiagame]Mafia YouTube[/url] channel. We’ll also be sharing a dedicated Steam post where you can watch our PAX East broadcast, streaming live right here on Steam! That post will be made at a later time.

We'll be hosting a special developer panel featuring the talented folks of  Hangar 13. Whether you're joining us live in Boston or tuning in from the comfort of your own home, you won't want to miss this!

[h1][b]MEET THE DEVS[/b][/h1]
During the panel our development team will deliver an in-depth look back at the last 23 years of Mafia, glimpses at how Hangar 13 brought the brutal underworld of 1900s Sicily to life in Unreal Engine 5 for 

[i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i], a Q&A session, and more development insights.

Meet the leaders who will be attending PAX East!

[list]
[*] [b]Studio President[/b], Nick Baynes
[*] [b]Game Director[/b], Alex Cox
[*] [b]Cinematics Director[/b], Tomas Hrebicek
[/list]

During the panel, we'll be revealing brand new details about [i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i] and giving you an exclusive behind-the-scenes look at the development process, officially ending Omerta.

[h1][b]Q&A: SUBMIT YOUR QUESTIONS![/b][/h1]
Not only are we discussing and showcasing new developments within [i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i], we would also like to open the floor to the community to ask us any burning questions you may have! Please use the Steam comments down below to leave your questions and the development team may answer them live!

[h1][b]RULES OF THE Q&A[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Please keep your questions relevant to the Mafia franchise or [i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i].
[*] You may ask multiple questions, but please don’t spam comments, please!
[*] Please be respectful in your questions and comments.
[/list]

In-person attendees might also expect a little reward for their show of loyalty, and for those who can't make it to Boston, be sure to check our social channels for additional news coming out of the convention.

We'll see you there, Mafiosos! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1941540/Mafia_The_Old_Country/

notes.title: Watch Mafia: Definitive Edition's First Story Trailer
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=2H-ooDBx8FM;full][/previewyoutube]

Welcome back to Lost Heaven. [url=https://mafiagame.com/mafia]Mafia: Definitive Edition[/url]'s first narrative trailer "[b]New Beginnings[/b]" is here, introducing newcomers to protagonist Thomas Angelo and giving longtime fans a cinematic look at how Mafia: Definitive Edition retells his story. The trailer first debuted as part of the [url=https://www.pcgamingshow.com/]PC Gaming Show[/url], where Hangar 13's Haden Blackman spoke to what awaits in Mafia: Definitive Edition. Soak in the sights and sounds of this reimagined Lost Heaven, then keep your eyes peeled for your first look at Mafia: Definitive Edition gameplay footage in the coming weeks.
